---
title: "Project Contract"
execute:
  eval: false
engine: markdown
---

The pipeline uses `data/inputs`, `data/intermediates`, and `data/processed`:

- `data/inputs` is the immutable staged-input boundary;
- `data/intermediates` contains derived Parquet files tracked as file targets;
- `data/processed` contains candidate and versioned release artifacts;
- `notebooks` owns the Manual and pipeline declarations;
- `scripts` contains generated command-line entry points;
- `containers` contains generated recipes and local runtime configuration;
- `artifacts/containers` contains unversioned SIF images;
- `_targets` contains unversioned targets state.

For the existing-wave migration, the hand-delivered May 2025 ZIP is the sole
source of scientific inputs and comparison data. The periodically synced
Google Drive/rclone tree is excluded from that migration because it can drift.
The separate 2025–2026 deliveries are not in this ZIP: pages 26–28 survey their
explicitly supplied source roots and plan a separately approved frozen input
manifest. Their survey scaffolding is not registered in the production graph
and does not change the historical comparison baseline. Page 16 extracts selected, unmodified
source members under `data/intermediates/archive_sources/`; these source
copies retain their original formats and are tracked as files. All other
persisted transformation products remain Parquet.

Workflow data stays in ordinary `targets` objects or in Parquet files tracked
with `format = "file"`. Source files retain their original formats and are
also tracked as file targets. The [pipeline map](pipeline/mapping/legacy-pipeline-map.qmd#workflow-data-storage-convention)
records the convention and its application across the notebooks.

::: {.manual-prereq title="Confirm The Repository Root"}

Run project commands from the repository root. The existing `data/`,
`notebooks/`, and `src/` directories should be present.

:::

::: {.manual-procedure .emit-generic file="{{ emit.project_root }}/.gitignore" title="Emit The Local-State Boundary"}

```gitignore
.Rhistory
.RData
.Rproj.user/
.quarto/
notebooks/.quarto/
.envrc
.spack-env/
.uvr/library/
.uvr/cache/
.container-home/
.container-tmp/
containers/runtime/local.env
artifacts/containers/*.sif
_targets/
*.out
*.err
**/*logs/*
**/*labbook
sandbox/**
!sandbox/.gitkeep
/.uvr/activate*

/.quarto/
**/*.quarto_ipynb
```

:::

::: {.manual-procedure title="Create Missing Scaffold Directories"}

```sh
mkdir -p artifacts/containers containers/bootstrap containers/build \
  containers/runtime containers/templates scripts tests/testthat
```

:::

::: {.manual-check title="Verify The Project Contract"}

```sh
test -d data/inputs
test -d data/intermediates
test -d data/processed
test -d notebooks
test -d src
test -f .gitignore
```

:::
